bullets.content: [general] One factor per solve (REPEATED mistake: h plus box changed together twice). Write the diff vs the previous mesh call before each mesh(); if more than one key changed, split it. Never go coarser than solve 1. Read compare stress_diff_energy_norm_rel and regions.

[general] Plan all 4 solves up front: S1 new candidate (never reproduce a known recipe), S2 single-factor variant or DOF saver, S3 x0.75 reference (h 0.006, ~9k nodes) for compare, S4 spare. Rank by compare(candidate,reference)xDOFs; submit best energy per DOF.

[general] Never call compare(x,x): it returns remeshing noise (0.0153). Call compare(k-1,k) on two different solves right after solve k and read stress_diff_energy_norm_rel plus regions. Repeated mistake. Use first-solve hotspots to place refinement.

[general] After solve 1 view(kind=error) from two opposite views (e.g. y and -y, or -z and iso); list top-5 hotspots with local h vs requested (a skipped check missed a 13% uncovered band). If h is 1.75-2x requested, use a box ~0.6x local h. If hotspots >=7% share are at <=0.0024 with <5% VM error, they are saturated: cut DOFs.
[general] Never submit a mesh identical to a peer's recipe: identical nodes tie on hidden points and lose diversity bonus. Change targets or h by >1.5x.

[general] If compare between the last two meshes shows stress change >~10% (e.g. 18.6%), the field is unconverged and above target. Spend the next solve on a globally finer mesh (h x0.75) rather than submitting.
[general] Never estimate field error from energy closeness to a peer/older run (guessed 7.9%, actual 11.2%). Use compare() against your own finer mesh.

[general] Pay-line selection (energy gain % >= 0.075 x DOF increase %) picked the class-best base. Energy differences <0.3% are remeshing noise; compare finalists against the same reference, never a remembered energy.

[general] Below the 2x target, score=(g/2)^2/c: halving error is worth 4x DOFs. Don't shrink DOFs while error is above target; size up until compare shows <10% change. With diffuse error, prefer concentrated refinement over uniform fine h.
[general] Quality gate is 0.1; 0.11 is valid. On abc_00000065_bc0 h 0.008-0.01 gives ~0.110 regardless. Don't promise higher; check each call, avoid <0.1 (0.1026 at h 0.011 elsewhere).

[general] Keep checking reactions vs applied loads. On a near-closed pressurised bore (f23) net applied force is a small difference of large numbers and varies with faceting; fine if reactions balance.
[general] One factor per solve, measured from current best. A two-factor idea (ymax 0.022 + upper 0.0048) taught nothing: price it free, then solve each factor separately.
[general] Use free mesh() calls to check node counts before solving. Near-identical meshes (5665 vs 5277 nodes) gave the same energy; spend the spare solve on one real single-factor experiment.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Baseline (a11: 17.5% field, 6.3% points, reproduced): h 0.0045 order 2, f2 0.0025, edges 39/8 at 0.003 r0.005. Repeating gains nothing; a4 with edges 39/8 at 0.002 gave 16.1% at 26.8k DOFs. Beat via boxes at <=25k DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a3: coarse h 0.012 with body box 0.0058 and edges 39/8/40 at 0.0025-0.003 won rank 1 at 15.5k DOFs despite 20.7% error. Cost matters; keep global h >=0.006 and refine only targets.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Order-1: one solve only. P1 at 5860/7979 nodes gave 0.0220/0.0226 J vs P2 ~0.0334 J (~33% energy deficit, est. field >50%). Submit P1 only if energy is within 1% of P2 control.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] P1 at matched DOFs: scale P2 sizes ~0.43 (body 0.0023, f2/edge40 0.0011, flanks 0.0013, h 0.006). Target 6.4-7.0k nodes; else rescale sizes by (nodes/6700)^(1/3) via free mesh() calls; quality >=0.1.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Front/back junction cells (x ±0.0058, y ±0.0129, z 0.0255) hold 12.4% error, outside flank boxes. Slab boxes at 0.003 r0.005 also cover saddle hotspots (±0.013, ±0.010, 0.024).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp box filled top cap (f21 792, f25 522 elements), black on error map. Use {edge:40,size:0.0025,radius:0.005} instead; a3 with edge 40 at 0.003 gave clamp cells ~3%. Saves ~1-2k DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Boss-root rim hotspots (±0.0195, ±0.0072, 0.030) hold 7% error. Try 4 points size 0.0025 r0.005 instead of edges 39/8; check f16 h<0.0042. If rims stay >0.0042, swap for ring box [±0.016..±0.023, -0.011..0.011, 0.024..0.036] at 0.0025.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle hotspots sit ~2 mm off f20 at (±0.013-0.014, ±0.009-0.010, z 0.023-0.026), h 0.0044-0.0051. Flank boxes must reach x 0.009 and |y| 0.016; a box ending at |x| 0.016 (a11) changed field only 6.9%.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 40 0.0025 on top of f2 0.0025: +0.46% energy for +4.6% DOFs (295 nodes, 1.5% stress change), marginal; clamp ring stays 14.4%. Don't go below 0.0025 (f2 0.0022: +9% DOFs, +0.39% energy, fails).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a13 rim boxes [±0.015..±0.024,|y|<=0.01,z 0.025-0.035] 0.003: 0.03304 J at 16.5k DOFs vs flanks 0.03333 J at 18.6k. Flanks cost more but reach saddle corners; flank choice gave best field.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Next call: control with only tier1 zmax -0.0058 -> -0.0062 (all else same: tier2, band 0.003, f7 0.0035 r0.006, upper ymax 0.015 0.0043). Accept if nodes <5277, q>=0.1, compare-ref x DOFs no worse; if nodes don't drop try zmax -0.0060.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp band (z -0.0081..-0.006, x 0.018-0.027) holds ~52% of error energy; hotspots sit z -0.0072..-0.0075 within 1 mm of f12. Edges 22/18 left h 0.0035-0.0043; use the tier1 box at 0.0016-0.0018 r0.003.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp layer z -0.0071..-0.0074 (x 0.019-0.027, beside f5/f7) holds ~37% error at h 0.0025 with 4-5% VM error: saturated. Tier1 0.0016 vs 0.0018 gave field 8.12->8.06% for +669 DOFs. Never go below 0.0018; cut DOFs there.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Changing all five sizes at once (0.0016/0.0034/0.0042/f7 0.0038/upper 0.0045) gave 5634 nodes, lowest energy; not attributable, do not reuse as base.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspot #4 (4.3%) near (0.014,0.018,-0.0068), h 0.0046, sits on band box xmin edge 0.014. Keep in control; later test band xmin 0.011 or mid-tier box to y 0.022 at 0.0035.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep f7 0.0035 r0.006 and upper box 0.004 in control. Upper 0.0045 gave 8.52% field, points 6.66%; not worth it. Self idea of upper 0.0055 to reach ~15k DOFs is untested but contradicts this.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a13: a2 recipe with tier2 0.003->0.0034: 5691 nodes, 8.34% field, base 0.747, e*DOFs 1424. Cheap DOF lever; test later in combination, not in control.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Node counts non-monotonic (dropping tier2 gave 6788-6831 nodes, quality 0.096). After each mesh() compare nodes to 6048 and 5825; solve only if quality >=0.1 and nodes differ from both.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspots #1-#3,#5,#6 (x 0.018-0.027, y -0.01..0.008, z -0.0072) at h 0.0022 hold ~35% error. Test tier1 z-range extended to -0.0045 at 0.0018 as only change.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Solve plan: S1 control, S2 tier2 0.0034 saver, S3 ~25k reference for compare, S4 best combo. Reference test: 18k->25.5k DOFs changed stress 6%; repeat it, it picked the winner.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Calibration: true field error ~1.3x compare(candidate, 25.5k ref) (0.060->8.06%). Rank by e*DOFs; base ~1063/(e%*DOFs/100).
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verbatim: 3d, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 Pa on f7, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3. Spread across runs is mesh-only.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Disclosed P1-P3 are 10-12% low in low-stress regions (x<0, far y); a 0.005 coarse box there could cut point RMS cheaply. Test later.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Coarser h doesn't cut DOFs: h 0.01 still meshes far faces f26-f34 at 0.0029-0.0034; h 0.012 plus full-thickness 0.004 box gave 7153 nodes vs 5327. Stay h 0.008; coarsen smooth-region boxes instead. Skip h 0.014 idea.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Avoid full-thickness boxes (z -0.0081..0.0081) at 0.004-0.0048: 7-8.4k nodes. Keep z-split: fine bottom tier, mid tier 0.003-0.0035, upper box 0.004-0.0045 limited to z>=-0.003.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Coarser recipe gave best check-point RMS 6.56%; field binds, not points. Keep wide band box over |y|<=0.026 for point robustness.
